meta.name: init-onecli
meta.description: Install and initialize OneCLI Agent Vault. Migrates existing .env credentials to the vault. Use after /update-nanoclaw brings in OneCLI as a breaking change, or for first-time OneCLI setup.

copy.tagline: 初始化 OneCLI 凭证库并迁移环境变量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚安装 OneCLI 或需要将 .env 凭证迁移到安全库
copy.tagline_en: Initialize OneCLI credential vault and migrate environment variables

howto.what: 安装 OneCLI 并初始化凭据保险库，自动将 .env 文件中的 API 密钥（如 Anthropic 密钥）迁移进去，然后重启服务并验证配置。
howto.when: 当你运行 /init-onecli 命令，或者 OneCLI 需要首次安装或重新配置时（如更新后）。

say.note: 启动完整的初始化流程。

say.text: 帮我设置 OneCLI 凭据保险库
say.note: 自动检测并迁移现有凭据。

say.text: 把 .env 里的密钥迁到 OneCLI
say.note: 仅当已有 .env 凭据时有效。

howto.what_en: Installs OneCLI and initializes the Agent Vault. Automatically migrates existing .env credentials (e.g., Anthropic keys) into the vault, then rebuilds and restarts the service.
howto.when_en: When you run /init-onecli, or when OneCLI needs first-time setup or reconfiguration after an update.

say_en.text: Set up OneCLI Agent Vault for me
say_en.note: Automatically detects and migrates existing credentials.
